verdict.rationale: Mintlify's documentation describes a Git-driven workflow. Content changes can be made via Git, each pull request gets its own preview URL before merging to production, and branch previews can be created or redeployed. Agents and the editor open and merge pull requests in "your docs repo", and a community user confirms the GitHub-app repo integration. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that merging or pushing to the default branch automatically publishes production, and detail on which git providers are supported or how the repo is owned and hosted.

support.subject: As a developer, my docs live in my own git repository — branches, pull requests, and merges drive what gets published
